name: SIA 497 询问起落架 前轮转向失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is Singapore 497, you are parking at gate 215, you have got information Papa, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Singapore 497，停在 215 号登机口，已收到 Papa 情报，请求前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA497, gate 215, information P, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA497，215 号登机口，收到 P 情报，申请前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: Singapore 497, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, Lima Kilo Oscar 01 departure, initial altitude 1800 meters, cruising level 10700 meters, departure frequency 118.9, squawk 2706.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 497，许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，Lima Kilo Oscar 01 离场，初始高度 1800 米，巡航高度 10700 米，离场频率 118.9，应答机 2706。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, LKO 01 departure, initial altitude 1800 meters, cruising level 10700 meters, departure frequency 118.9, squawk 2706, SIA497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，LKO 01 离场，初始高度 1800 米，巡航高度 10700 米，离场频率 118.9，应答机 2706，SIA497。

cards.audioText: B: Tell ATC 10700 meters is not acceptable due to heavy weight, request 9500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉 ATC 因重量大，10700 米不可接受，请求 9500 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA497, 10700 meters is not acceptable due to heavy weight, request 9500 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA497，因重量大，10700 米不可接受，请求 9500 米。

cards.audioText: C: Singapore 497, cleared cruising level 9500 meters.
B: You are on the taxiway Alpha with engine running, contact Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在 Alpha 滑行道上，发动机运转，联系地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA497, taxiway A, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA497，A 滑行道，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: Singapore 497, taxi to holding point runway 36 right via Zulu 4 and Alpha, hold short of Echo 7.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 497，经 Zulu 4 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 36 右等待点，Echo 7 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 36R via Z4 and A, hold short of E7, SIA497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，E7 外等待，SIA497。

cards.audioText: B: Contact Wuhan Tower and request intersection departure Echo 5 runway 36 right.
cards.audioTextZh: B：联系武汉塔台，请求跑道 36 右 Echo 5 交叉口离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA497, request intersection departure E5 runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA497，请求跑道 36R E5 交叉口离场。

cards.audioText: C: Singapore 497, negative due sequencing, continue to holding point runway 36 right, hold short of Echo 7.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 497，因排序否决，继续滑行至跑道 36 右等待点，Echo 7 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue to holding point runway 36R, hold short of E7, SIA497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，E7 外等待，SIA497。

cards.audioText: C: Singapore 497, cleared for takeoff runway 36 right, surface wind 350, 5 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 497，跑道 36 右可以起飞，地面风 350，5 节。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，联系武汉离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, SIA497, airborne, passing 600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，SIA497，已离地，正通过 600 米。

cards.audioText: C: Singapore 497, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, turn left direct to Delta Alpha, climb and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1021.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 497，武汉离场，雷达识别，左转直飞 Delta Alpha，爬升并保持 QNH 1021 上 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to DA, climb and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1021, SIA497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞 DA，爬升并保持 QNH 1021 上 3000 米，SIA497。

cards.audioText: B: You are approaching Singapore Airport, contact Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你正接近新加坡机场，联系进近。

cards.audioText: B: Your landing gear can't be extended normally, report this situation to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的起落架不能正常放下，向 ATC 报告这个情况。
cards.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA497, our landing gear can't be extended normally.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，SIA497，我们的起落架不能正常放下。

cards.audioText:
C: Singapore 497, what's your intention?
B: Tell ATC you want to terminate the approach, maintain runway heading, climb to 600 meters to complete the abnormal procedures.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Singapore 497，你的意图是什么？
B：告诉 ATC 你想中止进近，保持跑道航向，爬升至 600 米以完成非正常程序。
cards.referenceText: Request terminate the approach, maintain 600 meters on runway heading to complete the abnormal procedures, SIA497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求中止进近，跑道航向保持 600 米以完成非正常程序，SIA497。

cards.audioText: B: Your landing gear has been extended manually, but nose wheel steering is lost, request a tug after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的起落架已手动放下，但前轮转弯失效，请求落地后牵引车。
cards.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA497, our landing gear has been extended manually, but nose wheel steering is lost, request a tug after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，SIA497，我们的起落架已手动放下，但前轮转弯失效，请求落地后牵引车。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, Singapore 497, the tug will be ready upon landing.
cards.audioTextZh: C：收到，Singapore 497，牵引车将在落地时准备好。

cards.audioText: C: Singapore 497, you are number 1 to land, cleared ILS approach runway 18 left, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Singapore 497，你是第一架落地，许可跑道 18 左 ILS 进近，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: Cleared ILS approach runway 18L, report established, SIA497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可跑道 18L ILS 进近，建立后报告，SIA497。
